why: layers 5/7/10/12 were chosen against Apertus-1.5B; on a 36-layer model they would sit far too shallow. Relative depth is the comparable coordinate: paper 1 found across 38 models that the peak of linear decodability moves between models and aligns on relative depth
rule_fixed_before_computing: for each old layer take L/N_old and pick the new layer minimising |k/N_new - L/N_old|; ties resolved to the shallower layer. The rule is not changed if the result is inconvenient
split_file_unchanged: axis_rebuilt_split_20260925.json is a split of the stimuli, not of the model, so it is reused as is
